utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m pretty sure they still need a few more volunteers, and maybe some basic supplies too. I can check the exact list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Jules—please check the list and let me know what they still need. I’m heading to the corner lot now and can help load everything up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check the list and send it over soon. Thanks for helping load everything up!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds like it’s going well—thanks, Ira. I’ll keep an ear out too, and let me know if you hear anything useful while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I'll keep an ear out while I'm out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira—appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out here too, and we can compare notes later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they’re just getting it underway—do they still need more volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I think they could still use both volunteers and a few extra supplies. Saturday morning around 9 still works for me, and I can help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I can pass that along. I’m not sure what they’re short on exactly, but I’ll keep an ear out for more volunteers or tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll be there and get started whenever you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — really appreciate it. I’ll see you there, probably a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Dane — I’ll be there and ready when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s meet at the corner lot Saturday morning around 9. I’ll bring the hammer and extra screws, and we can head to the repair shop from there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm—are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can cover the hammer and extra screws, and I’ll handle my share of the gas if we need to drive over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can still bring the wrench set and screwdriver by soon for the repair drive. Let me know if you need anything else, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just bring the wrench set and screwdriver by, and I’m set for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Bo — I’ll swing by soon with the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can quietly spread the word around the block. If you hear the drop-off spot, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let you know the drop-off spot as soon as I have it. Thanks for helping spread the word around the block!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send it my way when you have it, and I’ll quietly pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center now, right? I can still help with sorting the donations and setting aside anything that needs repair.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Sunday at the community center is the current spot. If it shifts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll plan on Sunday at the community center and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good, but do we have the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded? I just want to make sure the repair drive stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — let’s keep it simple: it’s Sunday at the community center, and we’ll count items as folks arrive. I’ll confirm pickup details and share the final load list once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me, as long as you send the pickup details when you have them. I just want to be sure we have everything organized before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up again and keep nudging folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping it on everyone’s radar. I’m still a bit scattered, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep bringing it up, and we’ll make sure the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. If you find any gloves or a hammer too, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check for gloves and a hammer too, and let you know if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. That should cover it for now—just let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m checking the details first, so I’m waiting to hear what needs fixing before I help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Hana — I’ll check back later and let you know what needs fixing and what folks are bringing by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll wait for your update so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep bringing it up so the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center, right? I’ll let people know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Sunday at the community center sounds right — I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds like the repair drive’s really picking up—nice to hear. If you hear any updates, let me know and I’ll try to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll pass along any updates I catch about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah—appreciate it. Just let me know if there’s anything I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just give me a quick heads-up if the repair drive moves, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and I’ll see you at the corner lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll head to the corner lot then—point me to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — we’re mainly fixing loose cabinet hinges, a leaky faucet, and a couple of broken chair legs. If you can bring a screwdriver set and some wood glue, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ve got the list now. I’ll bring a screwdriver set and wood glue for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they’re getting started—do they still need more volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help spread the word quietly around the block if that’d be useful. If you hear of any drop-off spot, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out for a drop-off spot and let you know if I hear of any more volunteer needs too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — tape, nails, and a screwdriver would be a huge help. I’m just getting here late, so I’m grateful you all kept the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’m still keeping an eye on the repair drive spot, and I’ll let you know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you keeping watch. I’ll swing by as soon as I can and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, plus the tape and spare nails set aside. If you think of anything else for the repair drive, just tell me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that covers a lot. I’ll bring the hammer and extra screws—let’s meet at the corner lot and head to the repair shop from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the corner lot with the screwdriver, tape, and spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll swing by soon with the wrench set and screwdriver for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Gus — that’ll really help. See you when you bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll drop by with them soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa. See you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — we’re meeting at the community shed at 2 PM. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’m a little worried about the pickup details—where exactly should everything be brought, and is the corner lot still the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, bring everything to the community shed first, and then we can sort the corner lot drop-off if needed. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll swing by later and let you know what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. Are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not bringing anything this time, just keeping an eye on it and passing along what I see.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s still picking up nicely—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Ira—thanks for keeping an ear out. I’m still good for Saturday morning around 9 if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good to me—9 on Saturday works, and I’ll pass it along if I hear anything else while I’m out.
